sources.summary: Yorkshire shepherd Amanda Owen takes an old-school camping trip. Plus: a documentary for Agatha Christie fans. Here’s what to watch this evening 8pm, Channel 4 When faced with freshly plastered walls, what creative kid could resist adding a couple of little scratchy doodles? After discovering that her girls have already started leaving their marks, Yorkshire shepherd Amanda Owen wisely packs some marshmallows and whisks them all off for an old-school camping trip to Boggle Hole. While the ongoing farmhouse conversion dries out, it’s left to her ex-husband Clive and their son Miles to make the grounds look less like a building site. Graeme Virtue Continue reading...
